title: Effect of elevated CO2 on phosphorus nutrition of phosphate-deficient Arabidopsis thaliana (L.) Heynh under different nitrogen forms
notes: P-deficient (0.5 uM) hydroponic culture. Two N forms: NO3- (2mM KNO3) and NH4+ (2mM NH4+). Wild-type ecotype. Data estimated from bar charts (Fig. 1d,e,g). Text states: eCO2 increased P conc by 32% (shoots) and 21% (roots) in NO3- plants; decreased P conc in shoots by 27% in NH4+ plants.
